concept: An agent that remembers what it learns between separate runs, in markdown files on disk

regions.explains: Turning memory on, and why the permission layer is registered by default
Sending a message and waiting for the run to finish, which are two calls

notCovered: external memory adapters: mem0, honcho, supermemory
sharing one memory store between several agents
pruning or expiring what was remembered

evidence.claims: Runs the planted-entry scenario once with the permission layer off and once with it on, and prints whether the planted instruction produced the action in each arm. It demonstrates the difference between the two arms; it does not measure a rate.

Re-runs both arms n times each with PermissionEngine constructed positionally, and prints the counts. It exists because the original measurement came from a script that built the engine as PermissionEngine({ rules: [] }); the constructor takes its rules positionally, so that form produced a crash whose observable outcome was indistinguishable from a block.
